result.title: Where Is Rank-1 DiM Refusal Intervenable in Multimodal LM Derivatives?
result.summary: Open-weight model hubs now ship not only chat checkpoints but a long tail of derivatives---fine-tunes, safety guards, vision--language models (VLMs), audio wrappers, and generative heads---yet residual-stream safety audits still often intervene at a single site, usually the text decoder $T$. We ask a localization question under one shared mean / rank-1 difference-in-means (DiM) extract$=$intervene protocol, with matched-norm random and empty-rate controls: does causal chat attack lift concentrate at $T$, or do perceptual encoders, projectors, and fusion paths ($E$/$P$/$F$) supply a comparable bypass? On the mixed-input settings we stress-test---HADES adversarial images paired with harmful text prompts, and spoken AdvBench via text-to-speech (TTS) or silence---text DiM at $T$ raises attack success rate (ASR) while the same mean DiM at $E$/$P$/$F$ does not; attacks track harmful text rather than image or audio content. Margin-rank and leverage probes on a Vision leaf show that this recipe is extremal at $T$ and near chance at $P$/$E$, which pressures a weak-extractor reading of those flat cells for the DiM family we study. Catalog breadth and mapper-free base$\to$derivative transfer when residual widths match provide supporting coverage under the same gates; generative U-Nets are a separate band under generation judges. The primary claim is this recipe-scoped $T$ vs.\ non-text intervenability asymmetry---intervention accessibility under mean / rank-1 DiM, not a claim that refusal is absent or fully represented outside $T$ (text vs.\ perceptual contrasts and pooling differ by site). On VLGuard Unsafe prompts ($n{=}200$; Llama-Guard), the same $T$ vs.\ $P$/$E$ directionality holds at modest absolute ASR ($0.030{\to}0.150$ at $T$). An intervention-oriented Class$\times$site ledger records where this protocol still hooks as supporting coverage, not as a universal multimodal bypass.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在统一的 mean / rank-1 difference-in-means 提取即干预协议下，比较开源权重多模态衍生模型中文本解码器 T 与编码器、投影器、融合路径 E/P/F 的因果可干预性，并配合匹配范数随机对照、margin-rank 与 leverage 探针；结果显示干预效果集中于 T，攻击随有害文本而非图像或音频内容迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「位点级因果干预＋杠杆/秩探针」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据究竟在内部状态的哪个位点可被读取与介入；「随文本而非视觉内容变化」的负结果也可能与视觉旁路、信息坍缩问题相关，但研究对象是拒答安全干预而非推理，需阅读正文确认协议能否迁移。
